knowledge_point.title: Finding Exact Values of Trigonometric Expressions Using the Double-Angle Formula

question.:question/problem:
Without using a calculator, find the **exact** value.

$$
\cos^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)-\sin^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)=
$$
{{field-1}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
Use the cosine double-angle identity:

$$
\cos^2\left(x\right)-\sin^2\left(x\right)=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute the angle and evaluate the standard-angle cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&\cos^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)-\sin^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right) \\
&= \cos\left(2\cdot \frac{5\pi}{12}\right) \\
&= \cos\left(\frac{5\pi}{6}\right) \\
&= -\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right) \\
&= -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

knowledge_point.title: Finding Exact Values of Trigonometric Expressions Using the Double-Angle Formula

question.:question/problem:
Without using a calculator, find the **exact** value.

$$
2\cos^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right)-1
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Use the cosine double-angle identity:

$$
2\cos^2\left(x\right)-1=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute the angle and evaluate the standard-angle cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&2\cos^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right)-1 \\
&= \cos\left(2\cdot \frac{3\pi}{8}\right) \\
&= \cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right) \\
&= -\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) \\
&= -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

knowledge_point.title: Finding Exact Values of Trigonometric Expressions Using the Double-Angle Formula

question.:question/problem:
Without using a calculator, find the **exact** value.

$$
1-2\sin^2\left(165^\circ\right)=
$$
{{field-1}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
Use the cosine double-angle identity:

$$
1-2\sin^2\left(x\right)=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute the angle and evaluate the standard-angle cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&1-2\sin^2\left(165^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(2\cdot 165^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(330^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(30^\circ\right) \\
&= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$
